# nestjs-temporal-core

> NestJS integration for Temporal.io: auto-discovered activities, worker lifecycle, typed client facade, schedules, health checks, and opt-in bundling, error mapping, observability, encryption and test utilities. Peer-dependency library for NestJS 9-12 and @temporalio/* 1.15+.

Core rule: workflows are plain exported functions in a deterministic sandbox (import only `@temporalio/workflow`); activities are Nest providers (`@Activity` + `@ActivityMethod`) that do all I/O. Register once with `TemporalModule.register({ connection, taskQueue, worker: { workflowsPath, activityClasses } })`. Start workflows with `TemporalService.startWorkflow(type, args, { taskQueue, workflowId })`.

- [Migration guide](https://hmake98.github.io/nestjs-temporal-core/docs/migration-guide): including from `nestjs-temporal`

## Entry points

- `nestjs-temporal-core`: module, decorators, services, errors, utilities. Never loads optional peers.
- `nestjs-temporal-core/testing`: TemporalTestingModule, createActivityHarness, TemporalTestEnvironment, replayHistories (optional peers: @nestjs/testing, @temporalio/testing)
- `nestjs-temporal-core/otel`: createTemporalOpenTelemetry (optional peers: OpenTelemetry packages)
- `nestjs-temporal-core/encryption`: AES-GCM payload codec
- `nestjs-temporal-core/terminus`: health indicator (optional peer: @nestjs/terminus)
